decisions.statement: The pages of a turned page type are the ones the index names, each read from its own body.
A file that is no page is not answered here though its body loads as a value.
Every page the index names is answered where a property's unique kind turns.
No page is answered for a unique kind where no unique kind turns.
A page type whose slug the change leaves naming no page type strands its pages.
A stranded page is answered so the change withdraws what that page was filed by.
A page the change has is not answered here.
Nothing here answers a page for a relation the change turns.
Nothing here answers a page for an id the change leaves under no name.

definition: the pages a change files again though the change has none of them
